{{Libra}}
Libra 27 is the 307th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 27th day of Libra, and it is a Saturday. It corresponds to ISO week 44, weekday 6.

Its informal Japanese name is 11宮27日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 307|Chapter 307]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152326}}.

[[Category:Days with weekday Saturday]]
